text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff! Wheeze! Puff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (My legs! I'm going to fa—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hold on, I've got you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You ran spectacularly, Dober. Can you
walk?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove... I'm sorry... You don't have
to—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Lean on me all you want, and don't talk
unless
you really must. I'll walk with you
to the winner's
circle.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
Dober's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Wooooo! Dober! Dober! You were
incredible!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(...It's useless.
I don't have the energy to
face
them...)

text_block_list.name: Groove's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove! You were so, so close! You
did great!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Air Groove...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Will I ever be able to carry myself like
her?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: At the very least...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wow. I can't believe Mejiro Dober
clinched the
win! But... she's barely
standing. Do you think
she's okay?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, yeah, she certainly doesn't have

McQueen's consistency. I doubt she'll be
able to
snag a victory next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Dober...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The following day, I find myself
watching the rain
come down from inside
my office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm trying to get some work done in my
office
when Mejiro Dober walks in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright told me that a program about this
year's
classic racers is about to start.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
They'll probably cover yesterday's Arima
Kinen
too. I figured I should give it a
watch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since Mejiro Dober managed to come in
first at the Arima Kinen yesterday, the
program is bound
to feature her
prominently!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hopefully, this will help convince her
that she's
getting closer to building a
new Mejiro legacy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Is that a yes? I'll turn it on, then.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Moving on... Didn't Dober's performance
at the
Japanese Oaks remind you of
Mejiro Ramonu?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the Dark Duchess! She sure was
something. I
still have the image of her
running etched in my
mind!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
We can't talk about the Arima Kinen
without mentioning Mejiro Palmer and
her back-to-back Grand Prix victories!
Her runaway style is the stuff
of dreams.

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Mejiro Bright win the Triple
Crown also brought back memories of
Mejiro Ryan. You can't
help but want to
cheer for her, you know?

text_block_list.name: Commentator C
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. And we mustn't forget the
spring Tenno Sho if we're talking about
the Mejiro family!
Mejiro McQueen was
so impressive in it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the segment continues, Legacies of the Mejiro Family flashes across the screen, and footage of past Mejiros' feats is played back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The commentators continue lauding the
bygone Mejiros' achievements, and the
social media comments at the bottom of
the screen do much
the same.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's how the program ends.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The words fly from my trembling lips
without me
realizing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright and Mejiro Dober have
done
fantastically throughout their
classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And yet, no one was praising them for
their accomplishments. It was as if they
were just there
to help highlight the
other racers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Let it go.
choice_data_list: Why did it come to this—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I said let it go! To be honest,
I knew this
would
happen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday during the Arima Kinen, I
could tell how intense the senior racers
were—and how
inadequate I was next to
them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The people I admire—Ramonu, Ryan,
and so
many more—are on a level so
high, I can't even
comprehend it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It was fine when all I was doing was
blindly worshipping them. I was simply
proud and dazzled
by how brilliantly
Ryan and the others shone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I thought all I had to do was follow
directly in
their footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't until I started chasing after
them in
earnest that I realized how
crushingly steep the
trail they blazed is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And the closer I get to their light, the
more I find
myself imprisoned in their
shadows!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...They're so far away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I promised Bright that we'd forge new
legacies as
the next generation of
Mejiros, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I didn't realize how unfathomably far I
would have
to go in order to reach that
light.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm still so weak... so pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Still, you valiantly kept up the c...
But you kept taking on the challen...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks up in surprise, and I lock eyes
with her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: I've been watching over you like t...
I've been watching over you like t...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell her as many times as I need, but
Mejiro
Dober did an incredible job
during her classic
year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I haven't managed to stop
my
shaking...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Despite knowing the real reason why I
shake, I'm
still scared. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard she was trembling or
how
dispirited she felt, she always rose
to the
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know better than anyone how brilliant
the mark
she's left on racing history is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know how much work she's put in over
the past
two years, trying to forge her
legacy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: I won't let anyone say that—not ev...
I won't let anyone say that—not ev...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't care how many times I have to say
it until
she believes me. I'll say it a
million times if I have
to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ... All right, I'm mad.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm so mad and disappointed, Trainer! Hic... Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The pounding rain that falls on the turf
outside seems to mirror the stream of
tears spilling down
Mejiro Dober's
cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know it's my job to wipe her tears,
but I can't
stop my own from falling. Tearfully,
we swear to
make a comeback from this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And before we know it, the rain stops.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We still haven't discussed our next goal,
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to run in the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai, the spring Tenno Sho,
and the Takarazuka Kinen comprise the
conventional
path the best senior racers
take.
choice_data_list: From the Spring Senior Triple Crow...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Exactly.
I don't want to give up the fight. And I'm
not going to abandon the
promise I made with
Bright. Not yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We still have to forge new Mejiro
legacies
together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is now the Osaka Hai!
We'll shoot the flare signaling Mejiro
Dober's comeback right
there amid the
cherry trees at Hanshin!
